items.title: Axon Sinks 21% in a Month on Delayed Federal Drone Deals: “Just a Timing Piece”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAxon shares fell 21% in the past month after a revenue miss and an outlook cut tied to delayed federal drone deployments. Software and services revenue grew 43% and rival Motorola Solutions reported a record backlog, so the delay looks like timing.
